mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish: skies are overcast with a temperature of 78 degrees near the Military Ridge State Trail. The overnight low will drop to 53 degrees with no rain expected. If you are out tonight, keep an eye out for the space station starting at 8:21 PM, traveling from the west near Mount Horeb toward the northeast near the local Home Depot, reaching halfway up the sky.

In city news, Verona police responded to a burglary on Hunter's Cove Way on September 10th where a suspect was taken into custody following a firearm discharge, though no injuries were reported. Also, remember that applications are currently open for the Verona Police Department Citizen Academy, a free nine-week program covering topics from O W I investigations to K-9 unit demonstrations.

There is plenty to do in our area. Today, you can visit the Dane County Farmer's Market or enjoy live music at Bailey's Run, Paddy Mac's, and Lake Lou-ee. Tomorrow, the Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival takes over Main Street, and later this week you can catch trivia at various local spots.
On September 10th, officers apprehended a 19-year-old suspect following a residential burglary on Hunter's Cove Way, where a handgun was recovered at the scene.
Culver's of Verona is open until 10:30 PM today, serving the flavor of the day, Caramel Cashew. Stop by to enjoy a scoop before they close for the night.
